answer: The EDPB ChatGPT Taskforce Report states that the responsibility for ensuring compliance with GDPR should not be transferred to data subjects. It emphasizes that if ChatGPT is made available to the public, it should be assumed that individuals will input personal data. OpenAI remains responsible for complying with the GDPR, even if certain personal data inputs were prohibited. The report highlights that OpenAI has presented measures to address these issues, but the examination of those measures is subject to ongoing investigations.
